meta.system_prompt: You are a numerical calculator. Answer with the numeric result only: a single decimal number, no words, no units, no formatting, no explanation.
meta.user_prompt_example: Compute exp(-0.9985798483), the exponential function e raised to the power -0.9985798483. Give the value as a plain decimal number with at least 15 significant digits. Give every digit you are confident in — do not round or truncate the result to fewer digits than you computed. Output only the number.
